The Offer
Kanpur. The team hotel for the state T20, live on a regional sports channel. Marble floors. A chandelier. Nobody from Rajgarh has ever stood in a lobby like this.
Big fan, big fan! Sit, sit. I'm Sunny. Everybody calls me Sunny Bhai. Even policemen.
I heard about your Papa's plot. Very sad. Two lakh for prime land? Criminal. You can buy it back. Five lakh. Cash. Tonight.
Tomorrow, the match is on TV. All you do is get out before fifteen. Nobody gets hurt. Cricket is long. Life is short.
Take the money.
Five lakh. Papa's land back by Monday.
Walk away.
Say nothing. Tell no one.
Report him to the Anti-Corruption Unit.
The right thing. The scary thing.
You leave the lobby without shaking his hand. Your hands don't stop shaking until you reach your room.
The envelope is fat and warm, like it's been sitting in someone's jacket all day. You put it under your mattress. You don't sleep.
11 PM. A quiet man in a grey shirt knocks on your door. He shows you a badge from the Board's Anti-Corruption Unit.
Sunny has been on our list for three years. Nobody ever gives us anything we can use. Would you wear a wire for one more meeting?
Wear the wire.
Get Sunny on tape. Very dangerous.
"I've told you everything. That's all I can do."
Stay safe.
Midnight. The lobby again. A microphone taped under your vest. Your heart is so loud you're sure he can hear it.
Changed your mind? Good boy. Don't worry. Half the dressing rooms in this country owe me something. You're in good company.
There's a man in Delhi who places the bets. I just hold the umbrella. Get out before fifteen tomorrow and you're family.
Every word. On tape.
Story is ready. Ramesh, the builder, the fire, the plot.
My editor says if I get one more source, it runs on the front page.
Stay away from anyone who offers you money this week. I mean it.
Green Park, under lights. UP vs Bengal, live on TV. Last over. UP need 10. You're on strike, on 12 not out.
Before 15. Remember. 🙏
Three more runs and I break the deal. Get out and I break myself.
10 off 6
Live on TV. UP need 10 to win. What kind of cricketer are you?
UP win. Your name scrolls across the bottom of a TV screen for the first time.
You took my money and made me lose 40 lakh.
Five lakh by Friday. Plus interest.
Pinky's school is very close to my office.
You beat the bookie. Now the bookie wants his money back, and he knows where Pinky studies.
Bengal win by three runs. The dressing room is silent. You sit with your pads on for a long time.
You're caught at long-on for 13. Exactly as asked. The dressing room is silent. Only you know why your hands won't stop shaking.
[photo]
Nice photo of you taking an envelope in a hotel lobby, no?
Sunny Bhai says: welcome to the family.
Sunny Bhai owns you now. And he has the photo to prove it.
[photo of Pinky outside her school gate]
Cute uniform.
You said no to Sunny Bhai. He has just sent you a photo of Pinky outside her school.
